Commentary.Commentary: We are back with the action. The players are out in the middle. Dimuth Karunaratne and Oshada Fernando are the openers of Sri Lanka. Shaheen Afridi to start with the ball.
...Third Innings...

Sri Lanka will feel they have allowed this game to escape their grasp. That said Sri Lanka have been absolutely on the mark with their bowling performance. They came against a quality batter in Babar Azam and had they put a little more pressure on the Naseem Shah by keeping him on strike, things may have been different. The spinners have been good and picked up 9 wickets between them and Prabath Jayasuriya, as has been the recent trend, was the pick of the lot! One more Test five-fer and he must be feeling Test cricket is easy! Ramesh Mendis and Maheesh Theekshana contributed with two each. They will have to now begin all over again and bat well to set a challenging target. Stay tuned for the third innings.

Pakistan had a difficult time right from the beginning of this innings. No batter other than Babar Azam managed to cross the 20-run mark. It was the last wicket partnership of 70 runs that took them to this total and Babar Azam added 64 of those runs. He reached a remarkable century which was almost flawless and finally departed on a 119 to a standing ovation! An appreciation word for Naseem Shah's effort as well. It was his stubborn batting that allowed the stand to build and Pakistan to cut the deficit almost completely.

What a comeback this has been from Pakistan and all the credit goes to their skipper! This would probably be one of the best innings he has played to single-handedly overcome the spin challenge of Sri Lanka. They finish their innings on 218 and trail by just 4 runs in the first innings!

OUT! LBW! That is plumb! Babar Azam finally departs and his long vigil comes to an end! Maheesh Theekshana serves this slightly full and turning from outside off towards the stumps, Babar Azam looks to work this through square leg in the quest to rotate strike. Misses the line of the ball and gets hit on the pads right in front of the wicket. Pakistan have two reviews in their kitty and opts for it. No bat and three reds confirms the technology and the third umpire confirms it is out and asks the on-field umpire to stay with his decision! What an innings this has been from Babar Azam! An absolute pleasure to watch and its a shame it comes to an end!
Review taken! Babar Azam takes a review after being given LBW! Ultra Edge shows no bat. Ball Tracking shows three reds and finally, the 70-run stand is broken.
Full once again and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam comes forward and smothers this into the pitch.
Serves this really full outside off, Babar Azam digs it back out to Maheesh Theekshana.
Maheesh Theekshana goes full once again on middle, Babar Azam fends this back to the bowler.
Full delivery outside off, Babar Azam hit this through cover and this is good running to pick up a couple of runs.
Flatter and outside off, Naseem Shah lets it go to the keeper.
Full and on off, Babar Azam easily pushes it towards the vacant cover-point region for another single. Sri Lanka needs to stop giving these easy singles to Babar Azam.
On middle, blocked out.
Full and on off, Babar Azam goes for the drive but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
SIX! HUGE! This is tossed up on off, Babar Azam dances down the track and heaves it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie. They trail by just 7 runs now.
Tossed up on middle, Babar Azam defends it back to the bowler.
Flighted on middle, Naseem Shah defends it well.
Short again outside off, turning in. Naseem Shah blocks it to the off side.
A bit short around off, Babar Azam punches it through point for one.
What a delivery! Maheesh Theekshana bowls this slower through the air on off, holds its line. Babar Azam plays for the turn and gets beaten again on his outside edge.
Full and on off, Babar Azam pushes this to covers.
PEACH! This is tossed up on off, turning way sharply. Babar Azam strides forward to block but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Loopy delivery on off, Naseem Shah blocks it towards silly point.
A bit short outside off, Naseem Shah punches it of his back foot to short covers.
Full again on middle and leg, Babar Azam powers it to long on for a single.
Full and on middle,  Babar Azam comes down the track and digs it towards mid-icket.
Flighted on middle and off, Babar Azam gets to the pitch and plays it back to the bowler.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Babar Azam uses his feet and knocks it to the leg side with the inner half of his blade.
Tossed up on off, Naseem Shah knocks it to silly mid off. He seems unbreakable at the moment.
Flatter and quciker on the pads, Babar Azam helps it towards fine leg for one. Naseem Shah has one ball to survive.
Tossed up on middle, Babar Azam blocks it back to the bowler.
Full and on leg, Babar Azam drives it past mid on but refuese the single.
Slightly shorter and outsdie off, Babar Azam cuts it towards the vacant third man area and picks up a brace.
Flighted on middle, Babar Azam leans on and blocks it down the pitch.
Tossed up on off, Naseem Shah keeps it out well.
A bit short outside off, Babar Azam pushes it to covers and get across for a quick single.
Full again onto the pads, Babar Azam sweeps it easily towards deep mid-wicket but denies the single.
FOUR! This is full and on middle, Babar Azam goes down and smacks it through square leg for a boundary. 200 up for Pakistan.
Flighted on middle and leg, Babar Azam plays it back to the bowler.
Tossed up on middle, Babar Azam blocks it onto the leg side.
Prabath Jayasuriya (36-10-69-5) has the ball from the other end.
Tossed up, full and outside off, it spins in sharply. Shah looks to push but gets a fain inside edge there.
On off, kept out.
Flatter and outside off, punched to second slip, who collects on a bounce.

HUNDRED FOR BABAR AZAM! His 7th in Test cricket! While all other batters struggled, this man is playing with sheer confidence! Deserves all the credit and applause he is getting at Galle! This is on the pads, it is flicked behind square on the leg side for one. He removes his helmet and soaks in all the applause.
FOUR! Azam moves to 99! A full toss on middle. Azam smashes it between long on and deep mid-wicket for a boundary. The stand moves to 50 as well.
Tossed up on middle. Azam flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

We are back for the final session of Day 2. The Sri Lankan players make their way to the field. Babar Azam and Naseem Shah will look to continue this partnership. Maheesh Theekshana (22-6-57-1) will begin proceedings after the break.
... Day 2, Session 3 ...

Sri Lanka have been really good all through this innings but have hit a brick wall called Babar Azam. They picked up two early wickets in the session and looked set to take a healthy lead. Sri Lanka would be disappointed with a couple of aspects of their game. They have recently dropped way too many catches and missed opportunities that would lead to wickets. They would also but annoyed that they could not wrap up the last wicket early and had they done both these things they would have been right on top in this game! That said they still have a lead and will look to claim this last wicket right after Tea! Join us right after the break for the final session.

Yasir Shah’s stay at the wicket did not last for long after Lunch and Hasan Ali played an exciting, but short innings to push the total close to 150. Naseem Shah played a sensible innings and played the perfect support role to help Babar Azam flourish. He faced 42 deliveries and kept the Sri Lankan bowler’s out and in the end was the only batter along with the skipper to show any sort of application and resolve to battle it out on this pitch. Babar Azam is unbeaten on 95 and was the sole thorn in Sri Lanka’s side. What a batter he is proving to be! Placed in the top five ranking in all formats and deservedly so! He has put up what is a solo performance against the Sri Lanka spinners on a very challenging track. He will be looking for a well-deserved century after the break!

Sri Lanka have still not managed to wrap up the Pakistan innings and have been left frustrated by an unbeaten last wicket partnership of 46 while facing 144 deliveries! The tail has wagged for Pakistan just the way it did for Sri Lanka. The small cameos from Yasir Shah and Hasan Ali followed by a defensive display by Naseem Shah, in the company of Babar Azam have pushed their total to 194 and they trail by only 28 runs.

A bouncer, outside off and Shah doesn't attempt to play at it. That will be Tea on Day 2. Sri Lanka will love this break, it will break Pakistan's momentum and give a thought to how to break this last stand.
Fuller ball on off, pushed to long off for a single. Can Shah survive one ball before Tea?
Attempts an inswinger but slides it on the pads, it is flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Touch fuller and on middle. Shah defends it out.

FOUR! Naseem Shah is off the mark on his 39th delivery! He raises his bat on the occasion! An unfortunate one though! This is full and angling on off. Shah looks to defend but gets an outside edge, past the diving second slip fielder and to the third man fence.
Very full and outside off. Shah jams it out to covers.
FOUR! Azam gets a boundary but Naseem will be on strike next over! A loopy ball, outside off. Azam goes inside out over covers for a boundary. He is on 94.
A bit slower now, outside off. Azam pushes it to covers.
Flatter and outside off, punched to covers.
This one comes with the arm, around off. Azam punches off the back foot to Jayasuriya.
Foated, quicker and on off. Azam eases it to mid-wicket. Again no run.
GIves too much flight on off, whipped to deep mid-wicket for no run.
Flatter and around off, stays a bit low. Shah gets low to block it.
On off, Shah pushes it to point.
Azam moves into the 90s! Shorter and outside off, cut to deep backward point for a single.
Another short one sliding down. Azam pulls it to deep square leg but does not take a single.
SIX! KABOOM! Too short this on off. Azam clears his front leg and pulls it hard over cow corner for a biggie.
Too full on off. Azam pushes it back to the bowler.
An arm ball, this one lands on off. Shah leans to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. Nearly there but Naseem survives another over.
Slower, full and hint of away spin here. Azam leans and drives it to deep point for a single.
Fuller again on off. Azam lunges to defend it.
Tosses it up, full and on middle. Azam prods and blocks it.
Shorter and outside off. Azam slaps it to deep point for no run.
Okay, now Sri Lanka take the new ball after one delivery!
Tossed up, angling on leg, defended out.
The second new ball is available now. The umpire has the new ball but Sri Lanka have not opted for it.

This is brilliant batting from Babar Azam as he gets down to a full delivery on leg and works it with soft hands towards cover for a quick single to keep strike. Sri Lanka need to get their fielders tight as they concede these singles on the last ball pretty easily.
Full outside leg, Babar Azam gets his foot out of the way and defends it back to the bowler.
This one is slightly short on the pads, Babar Azam uses the crease and flicks it towards short leg once again.
Flighted full on the pads, Babar Azam taps this towards short leg.
Pitching on leg and full, Babar Azam gets forward in defense.
Dhananjaya de Silva bowls this full and down leg side, Turns away further and Babar Azam leaves it alone.
Babar Azam gets the single he wanted. This is full and on off, Babar Azam guides it to long off for a single.
Goes over the wicket now and decides to bowl this full outside leg, Babar Azam defends this down the pitch.
Tossed up on off, Babar Azam blocks it to the off side.
Takes the length back, and bowls this shorter. Pitching in line with the stumps and Babar Azam goes back to play this on the back foot.
Tosses this one a fraction wider outside off on a full length. Babar Azam gets a huge stride forward and defends it to Prabath Jayasuriya.
Full and just outside off, Babar Azam defends this back to the bowler.
Dhananjaya de Silva goes short and in line with the stumps, Naseem Shah goes deeper in the crease and fends it down the pitch.
Full and angled into the stumps. Naseem Shah showing a great exhibition of defensive shots.
Full delivery on the pads, The flick through deep mid-wicket gets him a single this time around.
Similar delivery, and Babar Azam plays the same shot and continues to retain strike.
Full and spinning into the pads from a leg stump line, Babar Azam flicks this towards mid-wicket.
Full delivery outside leg and spinning further away. Babar Azam leaves it alone.
On middle, blocked out.
Goes 'round the wicket and attacks the stumps from a full length. Naseem Shah fends this down towards short leg.
This one is turning onto the pads from outside leg and a fraction short. Babar Azam nudges it through square leg for a single.
Flights this full on the stumps. Babar Azam fends this back down the pitch.
This is closer to leg stump and full. Hits the pads and there is a stifled appeal. Clearly pitching outside leg.
Prabath Jayasuriya goes over the wicket and bowls outside leg stump. This is full and turning into the pads. Babar Azam does not play at this.
Too short and on middle, Azam pulls it to deep square leg for a single. It should be Tea time but the play is extended by 30 minutes or so.
Too full and on middle. Azam drills it to the right of the bowler.

An appeal for caught behind but turned down. Ramesh Mendis gives some air to this on middle, turning in sharply. Babar Azam misses his flick again. Niroshan Dickwella appeals for the catch but the finger stays down. Dimuth Karunaratne goes for the review but the Ultra Edge shows nothing and the on-field call remains.
Slower through the air on middle, turning down the leg. Babar Azam misses his flick.
Full and on middle and leg, Babar Azam flicks it to mid-wicket.
Short and down the leg, Babar Azam goes down and pulls it to backward square leg.
Tossed up on off, Naseem Shah knocks it to silly mid off.
Full on middle, Naseem Shah gets to the pitch and defends it onto the pitch.
Flatter and quicker on leg, Naseem Shah works it to square leg.
Full again on off, Naseem Shah is solid in his defense.
Flighted on off, Naseem Shah stays back and blocks it to the off side.
Full and on middle, Naseem Shah defends it well.
FOUR! Make that three in a row. Kasun Rajitha bowls another full delivery on off, Babar Azam plays the field and smears it over square leg for another boundary.
FOUR! Good shot! This is full again on middle, Babar Azam lofts it over mid-wicket for another boundary.
FOUR! HAMMERED! This is full again on off, Babar Azam smashes it past the non-striker towards the long on fence for a boundary. Naseem Shah showed good reflexes to get out of the way.
Fuller again sliding down the leg, Babar Azam flicks it through mid-wicket.
Another full toss but this time on middle, Babar Azam drills it to long on, denies the single.
Full toss on off, Babar Azam drives it long off.
Tossed up on off, spinning in. Naseem Shah blocks it out.

A huge appeal for LBW but turned down. This is flighted outside off, turning in. Babar Azam looking at the field tries to heave it over mid-wicket but misses the ball and gets hit on his pads. The Sri Lankans appeal but the umpire is not interested. Dimuth Karunaratne decides to go for the review but Ball tracking shows that the impact and wickets both are umpires call so the on-field decision remains. In all of this the batters picked up one leg bye.
Review taken! Sri Lanka take a reveiw for LBW! No bat there! Ball Tracking shows the impact is umpire's call while the answer for wickets hitting is the same as well. Azam survives.
Tossed up on middle, turning in. Babar Azam nudges it to square leg.
Floated on middle, Babar Azam pushes it past short leg, denies the single.
A bit short on middle, Babar Azam goes back and pulls it hard but it hits Oshada Fernando at short leg.
Ramesh Mendis starts with a tossed up delivery around off, Babar Azam defends it to the leg side.
Prabath Jayasuriya gets a break as Ramesh Mendis comes to bowl now.
Goes 'round the wicket and bowls a short ball on middle, angling away. Naseem Shah gets behind it and knocks it towards point.
Bangs in a bouncer on middle and leg, Naseem Shah ducks underneath it.
Slower again on a yorker length and around off, hint of reverese swing there. Babar Azam drives it to long on and takes the single this time.
Slower ball, full and down the leg. Babar Azam eases it towards long on.
Full again on middle, angling in. Babar Azam mistimes his drive towards long on.
Full and on middle, angling in. Babar Azam flicks it to mid-wicket but denies the single.
Naseem Shah survives. This is flighted on middle, Naseem Shah does well t block it out.
Slightly short on the pads, Babar Azam works it through mid-wicket for a single. Naseem Shah has one ball to survive.
Tossed up on middle, turning away sharply. Babar Azam tries to pad it but gets beaten and it goes through to the keeper.
Flighted delivery around leg, Babar Azam agains pads it away.
Floated on leg, Babar Azam lets it hit him on the pads.
Tossed up from 'round the wicket, Babar Azam pads it away.
After all the short balls, Kasun Rajitha resorts to a yorker right at the stumps. Naseem Shah gets his bat down in time and digs the ball out well.
Kasun Rajitha continues bowling short outside off to Naseem Shah. He sways out of the way to let it go through to the keeper.
Full and angled in from outside off, Babar Azam flicks this towards deep mid-wicket and now decides to take a single.
Bangs this one in short outside off, Babar Azam pulls this towards deep square leg and wants to keep strike.
Goes full again but a little closer to the off stump, Babar Azam defends this towards mid off.
Kasun Rajitha begins with a full delivery outside off, Babar Azam leaves this one alone.
The fielders are placed around the batter. Prabath Jayasuriya flights this full outside off, Naseem Shah manages to defend this through all of them towards point.
Full outside off this time, Babar Azam strokes this towards deep cover and take a single this time.
Prabath Jayasuriya delivers this full on off, Babar Azam takes a positive stride forward and fends the ball back down the pitch.
Short and wide outside off, Babar Azam looks to cut and gets a thick edge towards deep backward point. Not interested in taking a single.
Short now and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam goes back in the crease and fends this back down the pitch.
Prabath Jayasuriya goes full on middle, can not get through Babar Azam's defense as he knocks it back to the bowler.
Similar length and line, angled into the body. Naseem Shah defends this on the back foot.
Kasun Rajitha goes 'round the wicket now and bowls this slightly back of a length. Delivers this outside leg and Naseem Shah opens his body to defend this back down the pitch in style.
Short once again outside off, Naseem Shah gets well on top of this and guides it towards wide second slip.

Kasun Rajitha serves a short delivery outside off, Naseem Shah ducks under this on slightly but is considerably high. Maybe Kasun Rajitha remembers the short ball Naseem Shah had bowled to hit him straight on the helmet!

Kasun Rajitha delivers a slower ball, full and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam flicks this through square leg with soft hands and looks for a brace. There is no second here and Naseem Shah has four balls to face here in this over.
Kasun Rajitha begins with a full delivery outside off, Babar Azam drives this towards long off and refuses the single.
Kasun Rajitha (6-2-21-1) is back on.
Naseem Shah negotiates the last ball well! Prabath Jayasuriya serves this full on off, Naseem Shah comes forward to defend solidly.
Prabath Jayasuriya flights this full outside off, Babar Azam gets an outside edge towards point and they take an easy single.
Even fuller right at the pads, Babar Azam moves his leg away and plays it back to the bowler.

Some sharp turn here and beats the outside edge! Lobbed full outside off, Babar Azam looks to push at it and gets beaten by the spin! Good ball from Prabath Jayasuriya but still not getting that edge.
Similar deliver flighted in, Babar Azam happy to knock this back to Prabath Jayasuriya.
Prabath Jayasuriya flights this full outside off, Babar Azam fends this back to the bowler.

Not out! Maheesh Theekshana bowls this flatter and quicker on middle, Naseem Shah strides forward to block but gets beaten and get hits on his pads. The ball flies straight into the hands of short leg. They appeal for the catch and the finger goes up. Naseem Shah takes the review straightaway as he thinks there is no bat involved. The Ultra Edge confirms this and the on-field decision is changed to not out. Naseem Shah lives to fight another day.
Pakistan take a review! Naseem Shah is given out caught but he reviews it. Ultra Edge shows no bat. The on-field decision is changed.
This is pushed through on middle and leg, Naseem Shah blocks it from his back foot.
Flighted on off, Naseem Shah again is solid in his defense.
Floated on off, Naseem Shah defends it to the off side.
On middle, blocked out.

Not out! This is flighted on middle and off, turning away. Naseem Shah leans on to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge. Niroshan Dickwella takes the bails off and there is an appeal for stumping. The umpire sends it upstairs. The replay shows that Shah got his foot down before the bails were dislodged. He survives.
No run! Naseem will be on strike! Fuller and on off. Azam skips down and pushes it to mid off.
Shorter and outside off. Azam gets low and slaps it straight to the man at covers.
Flatter and on middle. Azam rocks back and flicks it to deep mid-wicket. No run taken.
Fuller and around off. Azam lunges to block it.
Sliding around middle and leg. Kept out.
Tossed up on off, played back to the bowler.
Flatter now on leg. Shah stays back and pushes it to mid-wicket.
Quicker, outside off. Shah gets his bat down to block it.
Tossed up on middle. Azam flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A loopy ball, outside off, driven to long off for no run again.
Touch short and slanting on middle. Azam fends it to short leg.
Very full and on middle. Azam eases it to long on. No run taken.

DRINKS! What a first hour we have had after Lunch. Sri Lanka have managed to take a couple of wickets but the enterprising innings from Hasan Ali and the determination of Babar Azam has pushed the total beyond 150. Pakistan still trail by 71 runs and there is much work to be done. Sri Lanka just need one more wicket to wrap up this innings.
Sharp leave! This was the arm ball, quicker and too full, just outside off.  Shah shoulders arms to it.
Flighted and on off. Shah steps across and blocks it.
TURN AND BOUNCE! Tossed up on off. Shah prods to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge. The keeper collects at a chest height.
So, Shah has three balls to survive! Too full and on middle, smashed to long on for one.
Straight on off. Azam defends on the front foot.
Slows it up on middle. Azam strides forward to dead bat it.
Azam gets a single! 150 up for Pakistan! This is full and quicker on off. Azam nudges it past the diving mid on fielder for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Azam tucks it to the right of the bowler. No run.
Drifts one in around off. Kept out.
Angles a full ball on off. Azam prods to defend but gets an inside edge in front of short leg.
Pushed fuller and on middle. Azam defends it on the leg side.
Targets the stumps on middle. Defended out.
He survives! Flatter and outside off, it is punched to point.
This is full and outside off. Azam drives it to covers where the fielder lets it through. A single. Shah has one ball to survive.
Another solid front foot defense from Azam.
Tossed up on middle. Azam lunges and defends.
On middle, blocked out.
Full and outside off, driven to covers.
Naseem Shah is the last batter for Pakistan.

OUT! TAKEN! Ali goes after playing a quick cameo! This is full and on middle, spinning in. It entices Ali to take on as he goes for the slog-sweep but fails to get the distance. Dinesh Chandimal at deep square leg gets under it and catches it. The wind was making the ball to swirl in the air but Chandimal hold onto it. Pakistan trail by 74 runs.
Commentary.Howout: c Dinesh Chandimal b Ramesh Mendis

Commentary.Commentary: Goes quicker now on middle. Azam tucks it to deep square leg for a run.
Floated, full and on off, turning in. Azam prods and bunts it to mid-wicket.
Shorter, spinning across, down leg. Azam shoulders arms.
Fuller and on middle. Ali smashes it to long on for one more.
A loopy ball, tailing on leg, Azam hits it to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Ali skips down and across to block it.
Slightly short and on off, Azam works it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Flighted ball, on leg on fuller length. Azam bunts it with soft hands to short leg.
Slower, full and on middle. Blocked on front foot.
Drifts one full and outside off, eased to long off for one.
Fuller and outside off, driven to sweeper cover for a single.
Flatter and angling down. Ali fends it to the right of leg slip.
Ramesh Mendis flights this full outside off, Babar Azam taps this towards cover-point and rushes across for a single.
Slightly short once again and outside off, Babar Azam covers the line and punches it to short mid on.
Goes full this time and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam fends this back to the bowler.
This one is also a bit short and outside off, Babar Azam rocks back and defends down the pitch on his back foot.
Ramesh Mendis serves this a fraction short and turning down leg, Babar Azam leaves it alone.

FIFTY! Babar Azam gets to his 22nd Test half-century and what a time to get it as well. This is floated on middle, Babar Azam steps out and works it to long on for a run. This has been a fighting knock and he has kept Pakistan still in the game. He will try to get close to the Sri Lankan total and reduce the deficit now.
On middle, blocked out.
Too full on middle and leg, Babar Azam nudges it through square with soft hands and comes back for the second easily.
Tossed up on off, blocked back to the bowler.
Full and on middle, Hasan Ali  eases it to long on for a single.
Darts this on middle, angling in. Babar Azam works it from his inner half towards the vacant fine leg region and picks up three runs.
Halt in play! The ball is not passing the gauge and it will be changed.
SIX! Same shot, same result. This is full again on middle, Hasan Ali smashes it over deep square leg for another maximum. He is looking to take on the spinners now.
SIX! HUGE! This is flighted on middle and off, Hasan Ali goes down and slog-sweeps it over the deep square leg fence for a biggie.
A bit short on leg, Hasan Ali tries to nudge it on the leg side but could not connect well.
Flatter and quicker around middle and leg, Babar Azam flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up on middle, Babar Azam blocks it onto the pitch.
FOUR! A freebie from Maheesh Theekshana. He bowls a full toss on off, Babar Azam drives it hard though extra cover for a easy boundary.
Full and outside off, Hasan Ali fends this down towards short cover.
Prabath Jayasuriya goes short on middle and gets the ball turning towards the offside. Babar Azam goes back in the crease and punches it to deep cover for a single.
Over the wicket now, bowls full and pitching on middle, Babar Azam defends this back to the bowler.
Flights this one full on middle, Hasan Ali sweeps this towards deep backward square leg and gets off strike.
Goes full now and just outside off, Hasan Ali defends this towards cover.
Short and outside off, Babar Azam works this through point for a single.

DROPPED! Tough chance but put down! Maheesh Theekshana flights this one full on middle, tempts the batter into going through with the shot. Hasan Ali hits this uppishly to the right of the bowler who reaches for it with both hands but only manages to parry it towards mid off. Maheesh Theekshana looks really disappointed and a chance goes begging!
Maheesh Theekshana goes full on middle, Hasan Ali continues to defend on the front foot back down the pitch.
This one is  a fraction short and angled into the pads, Hits the thigh pad, and lobs to short leg,
Full once again on off, Hasan Ali knocks this to the bowler's left.
Goes 'round the wicket now, bowls this full and on middle and leg, Hasan Ali fends this back to the bolwer.
Maheesh Theekshana serves this full and in line with the stumps, Hasan Ali fends this back to the right of the bowler.
Too full this time around off, Hasan Ali drills it to long off for a run. He gets off the mark.
Flighted delivery on middle and off, Hasan Ali defends it to silly mid off.
Shortish and outside off, Babar Azam pushes it of his back foot through covers for a single.
On middle, blocked back to the bowler.
Floated on off, Babar Azam knocks it towards silly mid off.
Nicely tossed up around off, again turning away a bit too much. Babar Azam leans on but decides not to play at it.
Floated on middle and off, Hasan Ali pushes it towards cover with the outer half of his willow.
Hasan Ali comes in now.

OUT! CAUGHT! This is smart bowling from Maheesh Theekshana! He has set up Yasir Shah beautifully! After consistently bowling a leg stump line, he fires a quick delivery full outside off. Yasir Shah reacts instinctively and looks to drive and gets a thick edge towards the slip fielder. Dhananjaya de Silva takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Dhananjaya de Silva b Maheesh Theekshana

Commentary.Commentary: Attacking the pads once again and bowled full, Yasir Shah works this towards short mid-wicket.
Maheesh Theekshana serves this full once again in line with the leg stump. Yasir Shah taps it to short leg.
Full and on the pads, Babar Azam clips this towards deep square leg for a single.
Goes 'round the wicket and fires this one full outside off, Babar Azam taps this back to the bowler.
Full once again angling into the pads, Yasir Shah nudges it towards backward square leg. Another maiden for Prabath Jayasuriya!
Full once again from Prabath Jayasuriya. This is pitching outside off and keeps is a straighter one. Gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Gives it some air on middle and off, turning away a bit too much. Yasir Shah puts a stride forward to defend but takes away his bat at the last moment. It goes to the keeper without doing any harm.
Tossed up on off, Yasir Shah defends it to the off side.
Full and on middle, Yasir Shah eases it to mid on.
BEAUTY! This is slower through the air on off, turning away. Yasir Shah tries to block it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Flighted delivery around off, turning away a bit. Yasir Shah goes for the forward defense but the ball takes a thick outside edge and roll towards point region. They cross.
Full toss on middle and leg, Babar Azam works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated from 'round the wicket around middle, Babar Azam knocks it to short leg.
Too full on middle and leg, Yasir Shah tucks it through square leg for one.
Full delivery angled into the stumps, Yasir Shah clips it to short mid-wicket.
Full delivery outside off, Yasir Shah looks solid in defense as he plays this down towards cover.
Prabath Jayasuriya goes a fraction short and angling down leg, Yasir Shah clips this towards deep backward square leg for a single.
This is full as well and pitching on an off stump line, Yasir Shah plays this back to the bowler as well.
Served full outside off, Yasir Shah fends this back towards Prabath Jayasuriya.
Beaten! This one is served full and pitching on middle. Gets the ball to rip off the surface and beat the outside edge of Yasir Shah's bat as looks to work this leg side.
Full once again just outside off, Yasir Shah fends this towards point.
Prabath Jayasuriya serves this full outside off and spinning away, Yasir Shah lifts his bat and lets it go.
This one angles around off and drifts away. Azam tries to play at it but misses.
Really full outside off stump, Yasir Shah taps this towards cover-point and takes a quick single.
This one is flighted wide outside off on a fuller length. Yasir Shah looks to work this through covers and gets an outside edge to deep backward point for a brace.
Full and wide outside off, Yasir Shah knocks this in the short cover region.
Served full outside off, fended towards the cover fielder.
Maheesh Theekshana starts off with a full delivery outside off, Yasir Shah defends this back to the bowler.
Maheesh Theekshana (15-4-26-0) takes the ball from the other end.
Prabath Jayasuriya bowls this full and in line with the stumps. Babar Azam happy to fend this on his front foot back towards the bowler. Maiden to start of this session!
Full outside off, Babar Azam looks to stroke this through covers. Well stopped by the cover fielder.
Continues bowling full on middle and leg, Babar Azam defends this down the pitch.
Similar delivery bowled full and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam nudges it towards short mid-wicket.
This one is tossed up full on middle, Babar Azam fends this off in the short leg region.
Prabath Jayasuriya begins with a flighted delivery full outside off, Babar Azam fends this back to the bowler.

We are all set to resume after Lunch. Both teams have had time to revisit their plans. Babar Azam strides out with Yasir Shah and they desperately need a partnership. Prabath Jayasuriya ( 18-6-41-5) will continue from this end.
... Day 2, Session 2 ...

Pakistan are pretty much living a nightmarish start! They have done everything they would have not hoped for in this first session. They lost Azhar Ali really early after which Mohammad Rizwan and Babar Azam put on a steady partnership of 40 runs. At that point, it seemed like the recovery was well in order. However, a mini collapse where they lost 4 wickets for 21 runs found them suddenly at 85 for 7. Babar Azam who is unbeaten on 34 sat at the non striker’s end and saw his partners fall one after another. They have a lot of work to do if they have to get closer to the Sri Lanka total and reduce the lead. Join us back after the break for the middle session.

Sri Lanka gave one over to their seamer this morning and immediately resorted to spin from both ends. Prabath Jayasuriya has been a revelation for Sri Lanka and he held up one end all session. He was rewarded with four wickets this morning and has now picked 3 five-fers in as many innings! What a performer! Ramesh Mendis chipped in with one as well. They did not take a couple of chances that came their way towards the end of the session. However, the Sri Lankans will feel they are right on top in this game and they need to continue the good work after the break. Any lead close to 100 will be massive in the context of this game.

Just the morning session Sri Lanka would have been hoping for when they took the field on Day 2! They have taken five wickets to put Pakistan right on the ropes and with nowhere to go! Pakistan would have hoped for a better start but the conditions have been really difficult and apart from Babar Azam none of the batters seemed comfortable at the wicket. They are reeling at 104 for 7 still trailing the Lankans by 118 runs.

DROPPED! Was a hard one as it needed something special! A low full toss on middle. Shah gets forward and sweeps it straight to short leg where Oshada Fernando had to get low to collect but he fails to hold on. He took one earlier but this one didn't stick. That will also be Lunch on Day 2.
Tosses it on off. Shah prods and blocks it.
Full, floated and on the pads. Shah misses his flick. Good collect from the keeper.
Too full and on off, flicked to mid-wicket.
Full and on middle, drilled down to long on for one.
Fuller and sliding down the leg side. Azam lets it go.
Tossed up on off, Yasir Shah knocks it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Nice shot! Prabath Jayasuriya darts in the arm ball, angling down the leg. Yasir Shah reads it and drills it through mid-wicket for a boundary. 100 comes up for Pakistan.
Flighted full outside off, Yasir Shah defends this towards the cover fielder.
Full and in line with the stumps, Yasir Shah knocks this towards mid on.
This is full outside off, Yasir Shah does not bother playing at it.

That is a chance! Prabath Jayasuriya bowls this beautifully flighted full outside off, Yasir Shah goes to drive and gets a thick outside edge. Niroshan Dickwella gets gloves on this and takes the ball away from the slip fielder who is diving to his left. Goes to his right towards third man for a couple of runs. Had the keeper left that alone it would have been an easy catch for slip.
Shortish and on middle and leg, Yasir Shah tucks it through square leg for one.
Full and on middle, Yasir Shah drives it straight to mid on.
Tossed up on off, Yasir Shah comes down the track to whip it over mid on but misses it completely and gets hit on the pads.
Floated on middle, Yasir Shah knocks it past short leg.
Loopy delivery on off, Yasir Shah goes for the defense but gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball goes just past short leg.
A bit short on middle, Babar Azam pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Flighted delivery on off, Yasir Shah plays it gently towards point.
Flatter and quicker around off, this is pushed to covers.
Floated outside off, Yasir Shah leaves it alone.
Tossed up on middle, Yasir Shah leans forward to block it out.
Floated on middle and leg, Babar Azam works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
A bit short on middle and leg, turning away. Babar Azam nudges it past leg gully for one.
Full and on middle, Yasir Shah sweeps it hard and it deflects of the short leg fielder towards deep square leg. They cross.
Tossed up around off, turning in sharply. Yasir Shah does well to block it out.
Flatter and quicker on middle and leg, Yasir Shah lets it hit the pads as it is going down the leg.
Floated on middle, spinning in. Yasir Shah misses his sweep and gets hit on his pads.
A bit short on middle, Babar Azam pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Tossed up on middle, Yasir Shah looks to block it but gets hit on his front pad. There is a slight appeal but the fingers stays down.
Arm ball around off, spinning away, Babar Azam has a wild swing at it but could not connect. Niroshan Dickwella fails to gather it too and the batters get a bye run.
On middle, blocked out.
TURN AND BOUNCE! He bowls it a bit short on middle and off, turning away a bit too much. Babar Azam lets it go to the keeper.
Full and on middle, angling in. Yasir Shah flicks it through mid-wicket for a comfortable three.
Tossed up on off, Yasir Shah blocks it to the off side.
Too full and on off. Azam prods and makes a solid block.
Tossed up on middle. Shah flicks it past square leg for one.
Tad short and on middle. Shah stays back and gets a bit of glove on it but falls safely on the leg side.
This one spins across sharply. Shah gets his pad in front as he tries to block it.
Fuller and on off. Shah pushes it back to Mendis.
On middle, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.

ANOTHER RIPPER! What a delivery again! Jayasuriya keeps his line and length accurate as he bowls around off, there is more bounce this time and it misses the outside edge by inches as it brushes past it. There is a stifled appeal as well.
RIPPER! Missed the Hat trick by inches! What a bowler this man is! Tosses it up nicely, fuller and on off and it spins away. Shah gets beaten on the outside edge as he tries to defend.

OUT! LBW! Another one bites the dust! Shaheen Afridi stands there knowing nothing what happened and gets a nod from Azam that it is plumb in front. An arm ball from Jayasuriya, tossed up, fuller and around middle and off. Afridi clearly wasn't out there ready to play as he was too late to get his bat down to defend. Gets pinged on the back pad and the finger goes up after a massive appeal. Prabath Jayasuriya is on a Hat trick.

OUT! TAKEN! Sharp catch by Oshada Fernando and Babar Azam watches another batter walk back! Beauty from Jayasuriya again! He gets his fourth wicket! Bowls a flatter ball, a bit quicker and slanting around middle and leg. Nawaz pre-meditates as he comes down the track and tries to flick it away but closes the face of the bat and it goes off the inner half of the bat and to short leg. Oshada Fernando had to show quick reflexes as he runs across to his right and takes it brilliantly. Might have lobed off his chest but he did well to hold onto it. Sri Lanka right on top.
Commentary.Howout: c Oshada Fernando b Prabath Jayasuriya

Commentary.Commentary: Nawaz waits back and plays it late to leg slip and the ball drops in front of the fielder.
A flighted ball, full and on off, steep bounce. Nawaz looks to sweep but gets hit high on the pads.
This one is spilled down the leg side, angled across. Azam leaves it alone.
On middle, kept out.
Fuller ball, angling on off. Azam uses his feet but doesn't reach to the pitch of the ball quite well, plays off the inner half and to mid-wicket.
A loopy ball on middle, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Slightly shorter and outside off. Nawaz works it away but just to silly point.
Beautiful delivery! This one lands around off, fuller and spins away. Nawaz is tempted forward to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.

Not out it is! A loopy ball, slightly coming off the arm, around off. Azam prods across to defend but misses and gets pinged on the pads. A huge appeal for LBW but not given! Prabath Jayasuriya was convinced that it is very close and asks his skipper to take it upstairs. No bat there clearly. Ball Tracking shows the impact is umpire's call despite the wickets hitting. Talk about inches. Azam survives.
Too full and on off. Kept out.
FOUR! Not a good line here! Jayasuriya drops it short, slow and on off. Azam rocks back, stands tall and pulls it past mid-wicket for four. Classy from Azam.
A loopy ball on middle, Nawaz sweeps it to deep square leg for a run.
Touch short and on off. Nawaz skips down and dead bats it.
Tossed up, spinning onto the pads. Nawaz lets it through and gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up, darting on the pads and turning away from the batter. Azam misses his flick.
Shorter, landing outside off and turning away. Nawaz slaps it to deep cover for one.
Mendis is getting a sharp turn here but could be better with his line! Shorter and on middle, it is pulled to deep square leg for a single.
Again this one is way down the leg side, spinning more away. Azam leaves it alone.
Shorter and spinning way down the leg side. Azam shoulders arms to it.
Tossed up on off. Azam leans and blocks it out.
Full and spinning in from outside off, Mohammad Nawaz shuffles down to wicket to defend and negate the turn.
Prabath Jayasuriya bowls a shade quicker and angles it into the pads from a fuller length. Mohammad Nawaz looks to fend this and gets a thick edge wide of short leg.
This one is full outside off, Mohammad Nawaz fends this firmly towards cover.
Goes 'round the wicket to the right-hander. Babar Azam looks to work the full delivery on middle towards mid-wicket but gets an inside edge towards deep backward point for a single.
Prabath Jayasuriya serves this full once again on the pads, Mohammad Nawaz clips this towards long on for a single.
Full and angled into the pads from over the wicket. Mohammad Nawaz knocks this to the left of the bowler.
This one is really full outside off, Babar Azam gets his front foot forward and smothers the ball into the pitch.
Ramesh Mendis goes short outside off, Mohammad Nawaz goes back in the crease and punches it towards point to take a quick single.
Full and in line with the stumps, Mohammad Nawaz gets forward and defends this down the pitch.
Pulls his length back a fraction, and serves this outside off, Mohammad Nawaz looks to slash this square of the wicket and misses.
Full outside off, Babar Azam gets across and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Ramesh Mendis serves this full outside off, Babar Azam looks to stroke this offside and gets an inside edge towards mid-wicket.
Mohammad Nawaz is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Massive appeal and the finger has been raised! Prabath Jayasuriya goes full around off and once again gets the ball to keep its line. Agha Salman looks to play for the turn and misses the ball as it goes on to hit the pads. The umpire says it is out and the batter decides to review this. There is no spike on Ultra Edge and Ball Tracker shows two reds and one umpires call as the ball goes onto clipping the top of leg stump. The on field decision stands and Pakistan have lost half their side!
Slows it up on off. Salman gets forward only to block it out.
Full delivery outside off, Agha Salman fends this towards the short cover fielder.

FOUR! This is a release shot from Agha Salman! The pressure seemed to be building! Prabath Jayasuriya flights this full outside off, Agha Salman sweeps this from outside off over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary towards deep backward square leg. First boundary for Agha Salman in Test cricket.
This is full and in line with the stumps, Agha Salman defends this back to the bowler.
Prabath Jayasuriya serves this slower in the air, full and outside off, Agha Salman paddles this to short fine leg.

Drinks! The spinners are doing their job and Babar Azam has been relentless in his batting. He needs the debutant, Agha Salman to help with the repair work which will not be easy as Sri Lanka are throwing webs one after the other. The pitch will only get hard from here on and it will be interesting to see how Azam plays it out.
Goes short this time and angles the ball into the pads, Babar Azam nudges it towards backward sqaure leg.
Full delivery angled into the stumps, Babar Azam knocks the ball back to the bowler's right.
Shorter in length and turning down leg, Babar Azam leaves this one alone.
Full outside off, Babar Azam fends this towards the cover fielder.
Sharp turn for Ramesh Mendis. Pitches this short outside off, Babar Azam goes back in the crease and gets cramped for space as he tries to defend.
Ramesh Mendis gets the ball to turn from outside off on a fuller length, Babar Azam strides forward and defends towards cover.
Prabath Jayasuriya tosses this one full outside off, Agha Salman gets a thickish outside edge towards gully.
Prabath Jayasuriya bowls this one full as well and in line with the stumps, Agha Salman pushes forward and gets an inside edge just away from short leg.
Prabath Jayasuriya tosses this full on middle, Agha Salman defends this back to the bowler.
Shorter in length and angled into the pads, Agha Salman misses his clip as the ball thuds into his pads.
This one is flighted full on middle, Agha Salman gets a stride forward and defends towards short leg.
Prabath Jayasuriya flights this one full outside off, Agha Salman looks to sweep and misses. Niroshan Dickwella whips the bails off and appeals for a stumping. The replay shows he is well in.
Stumping appeal! Ultra Edge shows no bat. The replay shows Agha Salman has his back foot grounded. Not out it is.
Just Short! Ramesh Mendis tosses it on middle and leg, turning in. Babar Azam leans on to block but gets a thick edge and the ball just falls short of the short leg fielder.
Full and on off, Babar Azam comes forward and blocks it down the pitch.
Agha Salman gets off the mark. This is darted on middle and leg, Agha Salman tucks it away to square leg for one.
On middle, blocked out.
FOUR BYES! This is full and sliding down the leg again, AghaSalman misses his flick and this time Niroshan Dickwella cannot stop it as well. The ball races towards the fine leg fence for four byes.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Ramesh Mendis takes a wicket with the first ball of his spell. This is short and down the leg side, Mohammad Rizwan tries to flick it from his back foot but only manages a glove towards the keeper. Niroshan Dickwella takes a sharp catch moving to his left. Should have easily avoided but he goes for it. Rizwan walks back without even thinking to review it.
Commentary.Howout: c Niroshan Dickwella b Ramesh Mendis

Commentary.Commentary: Ramesh Mendis comes into the attack for the first time in this innings.
Tossed up on off, Babar Azam leans forward and defends it to the off side.
Slower through the air around off, turning away a bit. Babar Azam is early in his shot and knocks it past silly point.
On middle, blocked out.
Full and around off, Mohammad Rizwan drives it through covers for one.
Flatter on middle and leg, Mohammad Rizwan pushes it of his inner half towards square leg.
Nicely tossed up on middle, turning away. Mohammad Rizwan knocks it to silly mid off.
Gives it some air on middle, turning in. Babar Azam pushes it to square leg.
Quicker and flatter this time on middle. Babar Azam defends it of his back foot.
Tries the carrom ball, down the leg. Babar Azam misses his flick.
Floated on middle, Babar Azam steps out and blocks it to mid-wicket.
Full and on middle, Mohammad Rizwan works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Good start to the over. Maheesh Theekshana bowls a full toss on leg, Mohammad Rizwan paddles it fine towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
FOUR! Nicely played! This is short again outside off, Babar Azam cuts it well past point from his back foot for a boundary. 10000 International career runs for Babar Azam!
Tossed up on off, Babar Azam defends it to the off side.
Full and on middle and leg, Mohammad Rizwan goes down and sweeps it to deep square leg for one more.
A bit short outside off, Babar Azam stays back and punches it past point for one.
Slower through the air around off, turning away. Babar Azam offers no shot at it.
Floated full on middle and leg, angling in. Babar Azam uses his feet and flicks it through square leg for a brace.
Floated on off, Mohammad Rizwan is solid in his defense.
Too full and on middle, Babar Azam gets to the pitch of the ball and drills it to mid on for a quick single.
Tossed up on middle, Babar Azam pushes it with his inner half past the short leg.
Full an on middle and leg, Babar Azam knocks it on the leg side.
Floated on middle, blocked back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, Babar Azam leans on and blocks it to the off side.
Tight on the stumps. Rizwan is solid with his front foot defense.
Tosses it up, angling on middle. Rizwan defends on the off side.
Little bit of width, fuller and this is driven to covers.
Overpitched and on off. Rizwan strides forward to block it.
On middle, blocked out.
Beauty! Slows this flighted ball ever so well, length and on off. Rizwan prods to defend but slight turn gets the outside edge to the right of first slip.
Fuller ball from around the wicket and on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Two runs! Too short and outside off. Azam punches off the back foot through covers for a brace.
Fuller and on leg. Rizwan tickles it fine past short leg for one.
Goes full now on middle, Rizwan turns it to mid-wicket.
Much better! Probably the carrom ball, shorter and outside off. Rizwan stands tall and defends inside the line.
Sri Lanka are lacking in accuracy! Shorter and on middle, Azam pulls it to the left of square leg for a single. Good stop there.
This is the arm ball, fraction short and on middle, it is nudged to mid-wicket.
Slows it up now, on off. Rizwan prods and blocks it.
FOUR! Again this is too full and on middle. Rizwan plays a straight drive past the bowler for a boundary.
Lands it full and around off. Rizwan leans and blocks it.
Pitched up and outside off. Rizwan watchfully dead bats it.
Floated on off. Rizwan stays back to defend it.
Tossed up on off. Defended out.
Quicker again, fuller and on middle. Rizwan whips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker and fuller on off, eased down to mid on.
Full and spinning into the batter, Azam tucks it past square leg for one more.
Pushed through on leg, clipped to square leg.
Too full and outside off, driven to covers.
Just one over of pace and Maheesh Theekshana (9-4-11-0) has been brought into the attack.
Perfect length! Gives a bit of flight here, fuller and on off, gets the required turn as well. Rizwan is beaten as the ball trims past his defensive outside edge.
Too full from Jayasuriya! Should drag his length a bit back. This is on middle, defended.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Rizwan prods and defends it to silly point.
A loopy ball, around off. Rizwan again blocks it.
Tossed up on middle. Defended out.
FOUR! Pakistan are putting away the loose balls! An arm ball, too full and outside off. Rizwan smashes it through covers, no chance for the fielder to chase it. A boundary.
On a length and outside off. Azam shoulders arms to it.
FOUR! Too easy for Babar! Slides one on the pads. Azam flicks it past mid-wicket and into vacant deep region for four more.
FOUR! First boundary of Day 2! Little bit of width here, on a length. Azam punches off the back foot and through point for a boundary.
Good start by Rajitha! This is full and outside off, jags a bit away. Azam waits and makes a late block.
Angles it on the pads, it is flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller and on off. Rizwan stays back to block.
A length ball, outside off and nips away a touch. Rizwan defends off the outer half to point. A no ball is given as Rajitha overstepped.
Kasun Rajitha (5-2-11-1) will bowl from the other end.
Nicely tossed up, full and on off. Azam prods and blocks it out.
This one lands outside off and spins sharply away. Azam watchfully lets it go.
Flatter and on leg. Rizwan sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Mohammad Rizwan has walked out earlier than he would have hoped for.

OUT! LBW! THREE REDS! What a start by Jayasuriya! Just the start the Lankan were hoping for! Jayasuriya serves a length ball, angling around middle and holds its line. Ali gets on his knee and looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. Sri Lanka put up a huge appeal and the finger goes up. Ali chats with Azam and takes the review at the last second. A desperate one to be honest. Looks plumb there! No bat confirms Ultra Edge! Ball Tracking shows three reds and Ali has to walk back!
Flatter and on off. Ali blocks it off the back foot.

PUT DOWN! Ohh! What a start by Prabath Jayasuriya! Dimuth Karunaratne puts down a dolly! This is full and outside off. Ali pushes it away from the body and aerially. Dimuth Karunaratne is standing at covers and he dives forward to catch it but spills it down. Should have been taken. Prabath Jayasuriya continues from where he left off. Creating chances.

We are all set for Day 2. The Lankan players are in a huddle before they disperse on the ground. Two overnight batsmen - Babar Azam and Azhar Ali to resume their innings. Prabath Jayasuriya (4-3-2-1) to start with the ball. Let's play...
Update - 10.15 am IST (4.45 am GMT) - Good news folks! The news coming from the middle is that the play will start at 10.30 am IST (5 am GMT). Stay tuned as the action is not far away.

Update - 9.49 am IST (4.19 am GMT) - It looks like we might have a delayed start as the covers are on at the Galle International Stadium. The live visuals show the sky is clear but the covers are still on. The good news is that the groundsmen are removing the covers carefully as there is a lot of water on it. The players are waiting patiently in the dugout. The umpires are out and we will have an inspection regarding the start of the match very soon. Stay tuned!

Pakistan trail by 198 runs. It looks like a huge score on this pitch where it’s hard to bat on. It will test the batters' ability to play the spin and the defensive technique may not work all the time on this wicket as the demons are live and Sri Lanka will have nothing but spin from both ends. Both the batters are relatively new so Sri Lanka will hope to make early inroads while Pakistan will need a big partnership and some disciplined batting to block things out, especially from the current pair of Babar Azam and Azhar Ali. An interesting Day 2 is ahead of us and let’s hope the rain stays away from the action. Stay tuned for further updates.

Hello everyone! Welcome to the action on Day 2 of the 1st Test match between Sri Lanka and Pakistan. The pitch at Galle is not what batters enjoyed the most and now the Pakistani batters have to grind hard to battle through these testing conditions. They have already lost both the openers cheaply and the batters at the crease will have to deal with more spin on Day 2.
… Day 2, Session 1 …

So, Pakistan still trail by 198 runs. Still, a long way to go in this match but Sri Lanka will attack Day 2 with spinners again and they will hope to make early inroads while Pakistan will hope for a big partnership. Join us on Day 2 at 10 am IST (4.30 am GMT). Join us for the build up as well. Till then, cheers!

Earlier, Sri Lanka posted a decent score thanks to a couple of cameos at the top, Chanidmal's brilliance in the middle phase and later, Maheesh Theekshana provided some crucial runs at the backend. Sri Lanka were 133/8 but two 40-odd run partnerships have pushed them to a decent total. Pakistan mostly used their seamers and they got rewards too. They kept on taking regular wickets to bundle the hosts out for 222. Shaheen Afridi was the pick of the bowlers with four wickets.

What a start to this Test match! Four wickets fell in each session, 12 wickets overall and it was certainly a hard day for the batters. Sri Lanka will be really happy that their bowlers have got rid of the openers already. Prabath Jayasuriya has picked up from where he left off. He asked a couple of questions already but the Pakistani batters negotiated him well in the end. Azhar Ali has been out for a long time but the important thing is he has seen through the day and it was important for Pakistan to not lose anymore wickets.
Tossed up around off, spinning back in. Babar Azam blocks it from his back foot. That will be STUMPS ON DAY 1.
Full once again on the pads, Babar Azam flicks it to short leg.
Full on middle, Babar Azam knocks it to mid-wicket.
Floated on middle and leg, Babar Azam tucks it to square leg.
Full toss on middle and off, Azhar Ali drillis it towards long off for a run. He is not happy with himself as it was there to be punished.
Babar Azam gets off the mark. This is a bit short around off, Babar Azam pushes it through covers for a single.
On middle, blocked out.
Full and on off, Azhar Ali dances down the track and drives it hard but straight to covers.
Tossed up around off, spinning away. Azhar Ali offers no shot at it.

EDGED BUT SAFE! This tossed up again on middle and off, turning away. Azhar Ali tries to defend it with soft hands but gets an outside edge. Luckily for him it does not carry to the second slip fielder.
Tossed up on off, turning away, Azhar Ali leaves it alone.
Floated around off, Azhar Ali leans on and blocks it to silly mid off.
Darts this one full on middle, Babar Azam digs it out onto the pitch.
Tossed up outside off, Azhar Ali goes for the drive but gets a leading edge towards backward point. They cross.
Flatter delivery angled in, Azhar Ali is solid in his defense.
Floated full on middle, Azhar Ali tucks it to mid-wicket.
Full again on off, Azhar Ali knocks it to the off side.
Full and on middle, blocked back to the bowler.

UNPLAYABLE! Prabath Jayasuriya bowls this slower through the air, full and on middle, Babar Azam leans forward to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge. Almost two in two for Prabath Jayasuriya. That ends a wonderful over as he registers a wicket maiden!
Babar Azam walks out to the middle.

OUT! LBW! That is plumb in front of the wicket! Prabath Jayasuriya has bowled beautifully in this over and he is duly rewarded! Prabath Jayasuriya bowls this full on off, and it's been delivered a shade quicker. Abdullah Shafique looks to defend but plays the wrong line to this arm ball and gets hit straight on the pads. He considers taking the review, then decides against it. Good decision from Abdullah Shafique to just walk off the field as this was surely headed for the stumps!
Prabath Jayasuriya serves this full outside off and gets the ball to turn away, Abdullah Shafique goes on the backfoot and fends this down the pitch.
Abdullah Shafique shuffles down the wicket and catches the ball on the full. Hits it back to the bowler who stops it diving to his right.

Beats him on the outside edge this time! Prabath Jayasuriya is bowling beautifully here as he serves this full outside off. Abdullah Shafique gets beaten by the turn this time as he pushes for it and the ball zips past his outside edge! What a delivery!

This one was really close! Prabath Jayasuriya goes a fraction full outside off, Abdullah Shafique plays for the turn and gets beaten on the inside edge as the ball keep its line. Some extra bounce on offer and the ball just goes over the stumps!
Similar line angled into the pads, and bowled short. Azhar Ali taps this down towards short leg.
Maheesh Theekshana goes 'round the wicket now and angles this in from leg stump from a shorter length. Azhar Ali clips this awkwardly towards backward square leg.
Goes outside off and full, Azhar Ali defends this solidly back to Maheesh Theekshana.
Even fuller, almost on a yorker length, and quicker in the air. Azhar Ali digs this out back to the bowler.
Full once again angled into the pads, Azhar Ali clips this towards mid-wicket.
Maheesh Theekshana flights this full on the pads, Azhar Ali taps this back to the right of the bowler.
Flights this one full outside off, Abdullah Shafique happy to defend this in the cover region.
Prabath Jayasuriya goes back to bowling outside off, on a full length. Abdullah Shafique fends this towards cover.
Full and pitching on off, Abdullah Shafique paddles this towards fine leg for a brace.
Prabath Jayasuriya goes full outside off, Abdullah Shafique looks to defend and gets a thickish edge towards point.
Full once again, flighted outside off. Abdullah Shafique hits this hard to the cover fielder who dives and stops it to his right.
Prabath Jayasuriya goes full outside off, Abdullah Shafique knocks this to the mid off fielder.
Maheesh Theekshana tosses this one full as well on the pads, Azhar Ali finds the same fielder.
Full and on the pads, Azhar Ali works this to the short mid-wicket fielder.
Slightly short once again and turning into the pads, Azhar Ali guides this to backward sqaure leg,
Full this time and angling into the pads, Abdullah Shafique clips this through mid-wicket for a single.
Maheesh Theekshana goes full and angles this down leg, Abdullah Shafique looks to clip this leg side but finds the short leg fielder.
Slightly short and on middle, Abdullah Shafique rocks back and works it towards mid-wicket.
Full and in line with the stumps, Azhar Ali guides this towards mid on.
Beaten! What a ripper! Prabath Jayasuriya flights the full outside off, Azhar Ali feels for it and is beaten by the turn. Unplayable delivery from Prabath Jayasuriya!
Full delivery angled into the pads. Clipped towards mid-wicket.
Full this time and in line with the stumps, Azhar Ali defends this on the front foot back to the bowler.
Pulls his length back slightly and in line with the stumps, Azhar Ali goes back in his crease and plays it back to the bowler.
Prabath Jayasuriya begins with a full delivery flighted on middle, Azhar Ali pushes this towards mid off.
Prabath Jayasuriya is into the attack.
On middle, Abdullah Shafique fends it to the leg side.
Full and on middle, Abdullah Shafique looks to flick it but gets an inside edge onto his pads. There is a slight appeal but the fingers stays down.
Azhar Ali gets off the mark in his 11th delivery. This is tossed up outside off, Azhar Ali goes on his back foot and pushes it to covers with soft hands. He picks up a single.
Darts this full and on the leg stump. Abdullah Shafique flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, blocked out.
FOUR! Abdullah Shafique looks to break the shackles. This is tossed up on middle, Abdullah Shafique uses his feet and just lofts it against the spin over mid-wicket for a boundary.
A maiden over by Kasun Rajitha. This is on a length outside off, Azhar Ali gets in line of the ball and punches it to short covers.
Great bowling by Kasun Rajitha. He bowls it full again on middle, nipping away slightly. Azhar Ali fends it to covers.
Good-length delivery around off, Azhar Ali covers his stumps and pushes this towards mid off.
Bowls it full on middle, shaping away. Azhar Ali blocks it back to the bowler.
On a good length once again, wider from off stump. Azhar Ali knocks this towards the cover fielder.
Kasun Rajitha starts of with a good-length delivery just outside off, Azhar Ali taps this down the pitch to the right of the bowler.
Keeps it full and on middle. Shafique solidly blocks it again.
Tossed up on middle. Shafique prods and blocks it out.
Full and angling into the pads, Abdullah Shafique nudges it to backward square leg.
Flighted full on middle, worked towards mid-wicket.
Flighted delivery on middle, turning away sharply. Abdullah Shafique flicks it down to the ground and towards backward short leg.
Tossed up on middle and off, Abdullah Shafique defends it down the pitch.
A wicket-maiden from Kasun Rajitha. He bowls it on a length and on middle, nips away slightly. Azhar Ali does well to block it to the off side.
Kasun Rajitha is getting the ball to swing. This is full and on off, nipping away. Azhar Ali knocks it straight to point.
On a length around off, Azhar Ali pushes it towards point.
Good-length delivery on off, shaping away. Azhar Ali lets it go to the keeper.
Azhar Ali is the new batter in.

OUT! LBW! Kasun Rajitha gets the breakthrough for Sri Lanka. He bowls it full around off, angling in towards the batter. Imam-ul-Haq goes for the drive but gets beaten by the movement. He gets rapped hard on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW and it is given. Imam-ul-Haq goes for the review. Ultra Edge and Ball Tracking shows nothing to change the decision. The impact was umpire's call while the wickets were hitting so he has to go. Pakistan lose their first wicket.
Good length outside off, Imam-ul-Haq leaves it alone.
TURN AND BOUNCE! This is tossed up on middle, turning into the batter. Abdullah Shafique flicks it and the ball goes on the bounce to backward short leg.
Darts this one on middle, Abdullah Shafique tucks it to mid-wicket.
Flatter and quicker around off, Abdullah Shafique fends it to the off side.
Slower through the air, turning in. Abdullah Shafique nudges it to square leg.
Flatter around off, Abdullah Shafique knocks it onto the ground.
Floated on middle, Abdullah Shafique blocks it back to the bowler.

Not out it is! A length ball, around off, it shoots and nips back in. Imam-ul-Haq tries to work it away but misses and gets pinged low on the thigh pad. A huge appeal for LBW but nothing from the umpire. Height might be the issue there but still Sri Lanka take the review. Ultra Edge shows no bat. Ball Tracking shows wickets missing. Sri Lanka burn their review.
Keeps it full and on middle. Imam-ul-Haq drives it back to the bowler.
Outside off, fuller, left alone.
On a length and targeting the stumps. Imam-ul-Haq keeps it out.
Very full, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq squeezes it out to point.
Fuller and outside off, nipping away. Shafique leans and pushes it through point for one more.
Imam-ul-Haq takes it on the full and drives it to mid off. A maiden then for Maheesh Theekshana.
Slows it more and angles a fuller ball, outside off, Imam-ul-Haq shoulders arms to it.
Flatter and outside off. Imam-ul-Haq punches it to point.

Edged but safe! A loopy ball, outside off, moving away. Imam-ul-Haq lunges to defend across but gets an outside edge, past second slip and to backward point. Sri Lanka have a backward short leg in place.
Sharp turn this time! Full and outside off, lands and spins away. Imam-ul-Haq leaves it alone.
Flights a slower ball, full and on off. Imam prods to defend but gets a thick outside edge to point. He is getting a bit of turn.
Lands it on a length and on top of off. Shafique makes a solid block.
Pushes it full and outside off. Shafique works it to covers.
On middle, eased down to mid on.
Angles it on the pads. Shafique tucks it to square leg.
Lands it full and outside off. Imam carves it to the left of point for a single.
Full and outside off, at 139 clicks. Imam leaves it alone.
Too full and on middle, floats it up. Shafique whips it to square leg. Good start by Theekshana.
Flighted, full and around off. Shafique takes a step forward and blocks it out.
Slightly short and on middle, nudged to mid-wicket.
Quicker, fuller and on middle. Shafique leans and tucks it to square leg.
Tossed up, drifting on middle. Shafique prods and inside edges his defense to short fine leg.
Starts with a fuller ball, outside off, turning away. Imam-ul-Haq guides it to backward point for a single.
Maheesh Theekshana will bowl from the other end.
Short of a length and on off. Shafique defends on the back foot.
Pitched up on off, it is driven to mid off.
This is full and outside off, makes it to move away. Shafique shoulders arms to it.
On a length and outside off. Shafique drops it to covers.

The groundsman has been called to tap the pitch at the non-striker's end. The bowler feels the soil is loose at the end of his run-up. This issue seems to be fixed now, we are ready to resume the game.
Five wides! Ohh! What was that! Rajitha certainly lost it! Full and way, way down the leg side, almost out of the pitch and no chance for the keeper to save it. It races into the fine leg fence.
FOUR! Pakistan and Abdullah Shafique are underway! A length ball, outside off. Shafique opens the face of the bat and dabs it past backward point for a boundary.
Starts with a fuller ball around off. Shafique pushes it to mid on.
